originals.role: Routine bodies, applicable history, and original comments. Later change records identify differences from this ROM.
The next source module begins with MFSRd1stDB, which establishes the end boundary.
HFS trap bit, signature, volume fields, and file record fields.
Parameter, position, end-of-file, and I/O error values.

spans.boundary_evidence: TFSBitTst begins at its exported ROM address 0x404eb8 and opens the surviving source module. The last DoPart branch ends at 0x4050fc, where MFSRd1stDB begins the next module.

changes.change: Restored MOVE.W IOtrap(A0),D0 followed by BTST #HFSBit,D0.
changes.evidence: The ROM at 0x404eb8 loads the trap word into D0 and tests bit 9. The surviving source instead tests memory directly, as its January 14, 1986 history records.

changes.change: Restored the entry names before the Trap suffix. Preserved their fallthrough into FileRead.
changes.evidence: The source history dates the name change to May 21, 1992. At 0x404f10 the ROM clears the position-mode byte; at 0x404f14 it clears the requested count.

changes.change: Removed later vector dispatch and processor-cache flushing. Restored the short FRNewLine branch and omitted ST CacheFlag before FlushCache.
changes.evidence: The ROM starts FileRead with BSR FSQueue at 0x404f18 and ends through CmdDone at 0x404fa8. Its branch to FRNewLine is short. The read-verify path loads VCBBufAdr into A1 and calls FlushCache immediately. The source dates CacheFlag initialization to January 22, 1986, vector dispatch to April 13, 1989, and processor-cache flushing and the longer branch to October 26, 1992.

changes.change: Removed the later FileWrite vector dispatch and processor-cache flush. Retained the source bodies for file extension, block reads, partial transfers, newline reads, and read verification.
changes.evidence: FileWrite begins with BSR FSQueue at 0x40502a. ReadBlock retains the alternate A6 stack convention and immediate cache release. DoPart saves D1/A0-A2 and calls through JBlockMove at 0x04b8. All instructions through the final DoPart branch match the ROM.

changes.change: Preserved the original header and applicable history and comments. Added reconstruction notes, required equates, external addresses, and explicit PC-relative JSR operands.
changes.evidence: The equate values come from surviving include files. The restored bodies use instructions and symbolic fields; no instruction bytes substitute for source.

verification.method: Reconstruction/Tools/verify.py assembled for the 68000, linked at 0x404eb8, and compared every emitted byte and all recorded labels against the ROM.
limits: The comparison proves the emitted bytes and label positions. It does not execute file operations, asynchronous calls, or cache and disk behavior.
External routines and the JBlockMove target lie outside this span. Their referenced addresses are checked here, but their implementations are not.
The original Mac Plus source and historical assembler output remain unavailable. Later source history explains individual differences but does not establish the ROM build date.
